Q: How do I solve AdjustCapsLockLEDForKeyTransitionHandling? A:

Change your keyboard Hotkey at Preference/Keyboard/HotKey/input method If your first key is CapLock, the error will show. Change the input method HotKey will solve.

Q: Extracting bounding boxes and category labels in MS-COCO dataset A:

2 years have passed. Now coco.py can already do what you were doing, by adding at the end some functions to map the annotations, converted into RLE format, to the images. take a look at this cocoapi.

Q: The DataAdapter.SelectCommand property needs to be initialized A:

Either you do it like this

 dr = dt.NewRow

 dr(0) = t1.Text
 dr(1) = t2.Text
 dr(2) = t3.Text
 dr(3) = d1.Value

 dt.Rows.Add(dr)
 SqlComand cmd=new SqlCommand("insert query",conn)
 da.InsertCommand = cmd
 da.Update(ds, "stagiaire")
 MsgBox("ajout effectu!")

OR

 dr = dt.NewRow

 dr(0) = t1.Text
 dr(1) = t2.Text
 dr(2) = t3.Text
 dr(3) = d1.Value

 dt.Rows.Add(dr)
 SqlCommandBuilder cb=new SqlCommandBuilder (da)
 da.InsertCommand = cb.GetInsertCommand()
 da.Update(ds, "stagiaire")
 MsgBox("ajout effectu!")

Q: Enabling ACLs + OAuth on an existing cluster required a full reformat, is this expected? A:

No, enabling ACLs/OAuth in KRaft should not normally require a reformat.

ref: https://kafka.apache.org/42/security/authorization-and-acls/

ref: https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/KAFKA/KIP-801%3A%2BImplement%2Ban%2BAuthorizer%2Bthat%2Bstores%2Bmetadata%2Bin%2B__cluster_metadata

ref: https://kafka.apache.org/39/operations/kraft/

ref: https://kafka.apache.org/39/configuration/broker-configs/#authorizer.class.name
